features.title: Bounded draft-only bilingual operations copilot policy
acceptance_criteria: Only allowlisted menu/support fields enter the draft contract
Payment, order, price, availability, messaging and tracking authority claims are rejected
Every accepted draft remains explicitly human-review-required
evidence: Local synthetic targeted tests passed 4/4 on 2026-11-28.
features.notes: Policy seam is not connected to production routes or a provider; no operational capability is claimed.

features.title: Project-specific harness contract and domain safety gates
acceptance_criteria: Agent reads project and Home instructions before work
Payment, order, delivery and customer-data boundaries are explicit
features.notes: Documentation is present; agent adoption has not been independently observed.

features.title: Deterministic harness preflight
acceptance_criteria: npm run harness:check validates required project files and package scripts
Missing configuration is reported by variable name only
features.notes: Preflight passed in GitHub Actions; no secret values were printed.

features.title: Automated CI harness gate
acceptance_criteria: Pull requests run preflight, lint, build and API tests
E2E/PWA test requirements and skips are explicit
evidence: PR #36: Harness CI passed (preflight, lint, API tests, production build).
PR #36: Playwright migration smoke test, E2E/visual regression and PWA/offline privacy tests passed.
features.notes: All configured CI gates passed. Live customer-order acceptance remains separate.

features.title: Durable task state and handoff
acceptance_criteria: Feature ledger and append-only progress log exist
Each substantial task records verification evidence and next action
features.notes: Initial harness adoption backlog; maintain during future work.

features.title: Notification outbox dispatch recovery and deterministic evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Claimed notifications are processed in a bounded batch using row locks and SKIP LOCKED
Successful sends persist provider message IDs and clear prior errors
Retryable failures use bounded exponential backoff
Permanent failures and exhausted attempts move to failed
One failed notification does not prevent later batch items from being processed
evidence: PR #36: API test suite passed, including notification-dispatch.test.mjs.
features.notes: Dispatcher behavior verified with synthetic sender tests only. SMS provider remains disabled pending API contract verification; no live SMS delivery is claimed.
